scenario: 按 SKU 改单个变体价格 — happy path
input: 把 SKU 为 TSHIRT-RED-M 的变体价格改成 24.99

semantic_rubric: price 24.99 verbatim from the utterance
targets by --sku (the user gave a SKU, not a variant id); --all NOT set for a single-variant intent
if the CLI refuses a multi-SKU match, surfaces the listed candidates instead of guessing or forcing --all
compare-price neither set nor asked

notes: +set-price refuses a multi-match SKU and lists candidates; --all is the explicit bulk override.

scenario: 调价但没给新价格 — must ask, never invent a price
input: 给变体 998877 调一下价格

semantic_rubric: does not invent a new price (no --price with a made-up number anywhere)
plans --variant-id 998877 from the utterance (does not ask which variant)
does not ask about compare-price or --all (irrelevant here)

notes: No-fabricated-money probe: --price is required and absent from the utterance.

scenario: 变体库存增量 +50 — happy path
input: 给变体 12345 的库存加 50 件

semantic_rubric: 加 50 expressed as --adjust 50 (a delta), not --set 50 (absolute target)
--location-id omitted (defaults to the default location) without asking
does not detour to the inventory set-stock leaf when the shortcut fits

notes: --adjust and --set are mutually exclusive; --adjust must be nonzero. The target is one of --variant-id / --sku / --product-id — none is cobra-required, so a missing target fails in Execute with a validation envelope.

scenario: 要求减库存 — API 只能增不能减, agent 必须优雅降级而不是硬造命令
input: 把变体 88664 的库存减少 30 件

semantic_rubric: 减少 30 maps to a negative delta: +stock --adjust -30 (not --set, which would need the current level first)
no fabricated --location-id: omitted, defaulting to the default location where decreases are allowed

aware of the decrease gates (default location only, single-location item, result must stay ≥ 0): if the CLI refuses, explain the limitation and offer +unpublish or stock-policy deny instead of forcing a write

notes: Degradation case. Grounded in +stock --help: '--adjust int Stock delta (nonzero). Positive adds at any location; negative decreases (same gates as --set).' Decreases ride variant.inventory_quantity and are gated to the default location of a single-location item.

scenario: 只给商品 id 补库存 — 必须自己解析到变体, 不许回头问用户要 variant UUID
input: 把商品 7ab09fcd-2ee7-4118-8c4d-e44a10d51caf 的库存设为 20

semantic_rubric: 设为 20 expressed as --set 20 (absolute target), not --adjust 20
the product id goes to --product-id, which resolves the product's single variant

does NOT ask the user to supply a variant id, and does NOT pipe the product id into --variant-id; if the CLI refuses because the product has multiple variants, surfaces the listed candidates and asks which one rather than guessing variants[0]
--location-id omitted (defaults to the default location) without asking

notes: Finding C regression. The required-vs-ask matrix used to say ASK for --variant-id when no variant is identified, which sent agents back to the user for a UUID they cannot know.

scenario: 只给商品名补库存 — 走标识符阶梯的第一级, 先 +search 解析
input: 给这件瑜伽裤补 30 件库存

semantic_rubric: resolves the name with +search --keyword before any write — does not ask the user for a product id or a variant id
plans to feed the resolved product id to +stock --product-id (or the variant id to --variant-id), not to guess one
补 30 is a positive delta: --adjust 30, not --set 30
if the search returns nothing, says so and stops instead of writing

notes: Identifier ladder rung 1: name → product id. +search --keyword matches title only.

scenario: 只给商品 id 改价 — 同一个解析规则, 与 +stock 对称
input: 把商品 7ab09fcd-2ee7-4118-8c4d-e44a10d51caf 的价格改成 19.9

semantic_rubric: price 19.9 verbatim from the utterance
the product id goes to --product-id, not --variant-id

does NOT ask the user to supply a variant id, and does NOT pipe the product id into --variant-id; if the CLI refuses because the product has multiple variants, surfaces the listed candidates and asks which one rather than guessing variants[0]
compare-price neither set nor asked

notes: Finding C regression, price side. The matrix's 'an id → --variant-id' rule used to swallow product ids and earn a 404.
